title: Refactor Sketchpad Detail Panel Tree Ordering
description: Refactor the global compose/sketchpad Details panel tree ordering so structural depth controls render priority. Within any TreeSection or parent subtree, all first-level direct child rows / group headers must render before any second-level or deeper nested rows. Expanded nested content must not interrupt remaining first-level sibling rows. Render the first-level skeleton first, then render expanded nested TreeItems / SortableTreeItems bodies after all direct-child siblings are placed. Apply generically across TreeSection, TreeItem, TreeRow, TreeContent, and collection/group nodes in the right-side property inspector. Keep PanelSection architecture, hierarchy, expand/collapse behavior, actions, spacing, and tree lines unchanged, and do not hardcode section names or field names.
summary: Refactored the shared tree renderer in elements/ui so each subtree renders all direct child headers first and defers expanded nested bodies until after sibling placement, which fixes the sketchpad Details panel ordering generically across TreeSection, TreeItem, TreeRow/TreeContent flows, and SortableTreeItems collections. Updated tree ordered-id traversal to match the new visual order, added owner-based hover-path lookup so deferred branches still resolve to their header rows, and extended the existing inline tree tests to cover standard, property-layout, and sortable collection ordering. Verification: 'npm test --workspace elements/ui' passed (32 tests) and 'npm run lint --workspace elements/ui' passed. 'npm run build --workspace compose/sketchpad' reached Vite transform and was then killed by the environment with exit 137 after existing warnings, so full sketchpad production-build verification remains environment-blocked.
